answer: Name: Tri-channel residual clustering. After settlement, logs are reduced to three residuals—sable (inter-arrival timing), pearl (payload entropy), jetty (ASN/route)—then whitened per task class. A mixture model flags account groups whose residual covariance matrix has near-unit rank across all channels. Cost: sybils must independently randomize timing, payloads, and infrastructure/payment paths, cutting throughput and raising ops cost; flagged clusters face delayed payouts pending audit.
